note: Unique-species suit proving the four-crew framework. Each card uses a unique bird species reserved away from the Major and Aviary Legends species.

suit.name: Basins
suit.habitat: modern canals, rain-slick streets, underpasses, harbor railings, utility fountains
suit.borderFrame: Use the shared Bird Squad frame structure: dark outer keyline, gilded inner filigree rail, four corner medallions, slim vertical side rails, top suit crest medallion, and bottom title cartouche. Keep frame thickness, symmetry, border width, and title placement consistent; place wave and droplet motifs inside the established frame zones.
suit.coreRule: All subjects anatomically bird; streetwear fitted to bird anatomy; no humanoid forms; no gore. Birds have no hands, fingers, wing-hands, wing-arms, extra wings, extra legs, or extra limbs; held props use beak, talons, feet, or legs only. Basin pip counts must use the one count element named on the card and be integrated into care scenes through vessels, reflected vessels, rain-basin marks, canal lights, or objects the birds are using; avoid alternate count objects, pasted icon rows, isolated prop clusters, and extra basin-like clutter that could overcount. No readable text on clothing; suit-coded streetwear should use abstract motifs, color, material, and accessories without gang-coded uniforms or affiliation marks. Do not mix bird species on a card; additional birds, if needed, must be the same listed species and match the described bird count exactly.

cards.name: Open Basin
cards.coreMeaning: New love, open heart, emotional source
cards.description: A Great Blue Heron lifts one brimming dew-vessel from a modern utility fountain on a rain-slick canal walk, using only beak and talons.
cards.pose: Standing tall in shallow canal water, neck curved up, both wings folded against the body, exactly one brimming dew-vessel steadied between beak and talons; no arm, hand, sleeve, palm, or wing-tip grasp.
cards.varietyNotes: Suit anchor species. Vertical heron silhouette + overflowing water reads 'source' instantly.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Opens emotion/bond resources; a wellspring card that fuels later Basins plays.

numberSymbolism.element: one brimming dew-vessel at the utility fountain
numberSymbolism.represents: an open emotional offer, healing source, and first act of care
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly one basin/dew-vessel steadied by the Great Blue Heron's beak and talons; both wings remain folded or naturally posed, with no arm, hand, sleeve, palm, or wing-tip grasp.

cards.repairDirective: Previous candidates gave the bird arm-like side limbs while holding the basin. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only. The vessel must be held only by beak and talons, with wings clearly folded as wings under the rain cape; no sleeve-arm, hand, palm, elbow, shoulder, or humanoid clothing silhouette. Keep the heron and the one vessel centered inside the overlay-safe area.

cards.name: Twin Basin Bond
cards.description: Two mergansers mirror each other in a courtship display over still water.
cards.pose: Paired symmetrical pose, crests raised, beaks nearly touching above a shared reflection.
cards.varietyNotes: Two-subject mirror composition; raised crests give a distinct silhouette from the heron pips.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Pairs two crew cards; enables synergy/commitment effects between bonded cards.

numberSymbolism.element: two paired basin reflections between the mirrored mergansers
numberSymbolism.represents: mutual bond, reciprocity, and balanced care
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly two basin vessels or two clear reflection rings between the Hooded Mergansers.

cards.name: Basin Chorus
cards.description: Three Roseate Spoonbills of the same species splash together in a modern fountain in shared celebration.
cards.pose: Three Roseate Spoonbills mid-splash, wings half-open, spatulate bills lifted, water droplets flying.
cards.varietyNotes: Pink + spatulate bill clearly separates spoonbills from the heron and ducks of the suit.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Group buff; rewards having multiple friendly Basins crew cards active in the encounter.

numberSymbolism.element: three fountain basins or splash arcs around the spoonbills
numberSymbolism.represents: shared joy, chorus, and community celebration
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly three basin markers, fountain cups, or splash arcs around the Roseate Spoonbills.

cards.name: Closed Basin
cards.description: A Green Heron ignores exactly four closed basin vessels at a modern canal shelter, one offered and three untouched on the ledge.
cards.pose: Hunched on one leg under heavy rain, head withdrawn into shoulders, back turned to exactly four closed basin vessels: three capped vessels on the wet canal ledge and one offered vessel bobbing nearby.
cards.varietyNotes: Same heron as the Ace, inverted in mood — hunched/closed silhouette vs. the Ace's open lift.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A pass/skip or disengage card; trades a turn of action for later focus.

numberSymbolism.element: four closed basin vessels at the canal shelter
numberSymbolism.represents: withdrawal, emotional refusal, and an unopened offer
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly four basin vessels total: three capped vessels on the wet ledge plus one offered vessel bobbing nearby. Do not add extra bowls, cups, reflections, lights, or basin-shaped props.

cards.repairDirective: Previous candidates had the correct four basins in the raw art but the final border cropped one. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with all four basin vessels clustered closer to the center, comfortably inside the overlay-safe area, one full pip-width away from the future border and title cartouche. Keep the Green Heron centered and do not place any count object near an edge.

cards.name: Spilled Basin
cards.description: A wood duck turns away in grief after tipping three vessels in the gutter, while two basins still stand behind it.
cards.pose: Turned away and lowered near the center of the canal ledge, gaze pulled back toward exactly five basin vessels placed fully inside the overlay-safe center: three tipped vessels and two upright vessels behind.
cards.varietyNotes: Wood Duck's ornate head pattern reads even when hunched; the two lit basins keep hope in frame.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Discard/sacrifice with a recovery clause — something remains after the loss.

numberSymbolism.element: five basin vessels split between three spilled and two still standing
numberSymbolism.represents: loss, grief, and the remaining care that has not been noticed yet
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly five basins total: three tipped and two upright behind the Wood Duck. Keep all five vessels close to the center of the scene and away from the future border; do not crop, hide, reflect, or duplicate them.

cards.repairDirective: Previous candidates placed basin count elements too close to the future border. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only, with all five basin vessels clearly centered inside the safe image area and no countable reflections or edge-cropped vessels.

cards.name: Basin Memory
cards.description: Two Sanderlings share food at a city fountain while exactly six capped basin cups line the wet fountain rim.
cards.pose: Two Sanderlings of the same species share food at a modern fountain edge, with exactly six small capped basin cups clipped into the fountain rim around them.
cards.varietyNotes: Small busy shorebird scale contrasts the suit's tall waders; two-size pairing tells the story.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Gift/transfer effect; move a resource or buff from one crew card to another.

numberSymbolism.element: six capped basin cups clipped into the fountain rim
numberSymbolism.represents: kindness across ages, remembered care, and generous return
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly six capped basin cups clipped into the fountain rim around the Sanderlings; do not add care tokens, shine tags, extra vessels, extra lights, or reflections that could be counted.

cards.repairDirective: Latest review found the card reading too realistic. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with crisp clusters, deliberate dithering, and visible pixel structure; reject realistic painting or soft digital rendering. Keep the scene unmistakably Basins: modern rainwear, fountain edge, water, and exactly six capped basin cups clipped into the fountain rim as the only countable pips. Keep all six cups centered well inside the final border opening with no extra vessels, lights, reflections, or shine tags.

cards.name: Basin Mirage
cards.description: A bird gazes into rainwater reflections, shop-window glare, and canal lights that suggest too many choices.
cards.pose: Centered in the safe image area, head tilted toward exactly seven reflected basin choices arranged close around it in rainwater and shop glass, with no reflection near the future border.
cards.varietyNotes: Dusk-violet accent and layered rainwater reflections set it apart visually from the grounded pips.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Choose-one / scry effect; reveal options, but some are decoys.

numberSymbolism.element: seven rainwater reflections or shop-window basin choices
numberSymbolism.represents: temptation, fantasy, and too many emotional options
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly seven reflected basin images or choice-reflections around the Mandarin Duck. Keep all seven reflections fully inside the overlay-safe center and away from borders; do not add extra reflected choices, lights, bowls, or cropped partial reflections.

cards.repairDirective: Latest review found eight basin choices instead of seven. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with the Mandarin Duck and exactly seven basin-choice reflections total, all pulled inward and centered. Use one countable object family only; no eighth reflection, no extra bowl, no partial basin, no reflected rim, no edge pip, and no vessel-like background light that could be counted.

cards.name: Basin Walkaway
cards.description: A Black Skimmer leaves a neat row of arranged basins behind, gliding low down the canal into dusk rain.
cards.pose: Seen low and side-on mid-glide, oversized lower bill skimming rainwater as it leaves eight vessels lined on the bank, moon low ahead.
cards.varietyNotes: The blade-like skimmer bill and low flight angle break up the repeated heron silhouettes in Basins.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Voluntary retreat; abandon a position to set up a stronger one elsewhere.

numberSymbolism.element: eight arranged basin vessels left behind on the canal bank
numberSymbolism.represents: walking away, emotional search, and leaving a full pattern unfinished
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly eight basins behind the Black Skimmer as it departs low over the water.

cards.name: Full Basin Row
cards.description: A content Scarlet Ibis settles before exactly nine full basins on a modern canal ledge, satisfied and still.
cards.pose: Settled and satisfied, wings tucked, with exactly nine full basin vessels arranged in one proud arc on the wet ledge behind it, reflections blurred so they cannot be counted.
cards.varietyNotes: Pink + gold abundance palette signals the 'wish' high point of the suit.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Payoff card; cash in accumulated emotion resources for a strong reward.

numberSymbolism.element: nine full basins arranged in one proud arc
numberSymbolism.represents: contentment, satisfaction, and a cared-for wish fulfilled
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly nine full basin vessels in one clear arc behind or around the Scarlet Ibis; reflections must be soft and non-countable, with no extra basin vessels or bowl-like props.

cards.repairDirective: Latest review found the card reading too realistic. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with crisp clusters, deliberate dithering, and visible pixel structure; reject realistic painting or soft digital rendering. Use one countable centered arc of exactly nine full basin vessels and keep all reflections visually soft, broken, or non-countable so they cannot read as extra basins.

cards.name: Canal Shelter
cards.description: A Mallard family group gathers under exactly ten oval canal-light basin markers at a modern waterfront shelter.
cards.pose: Exactly ten Mallards of the same species huddle close together in the center of the waterfront shelter, under exactly ten oval canal-light basin markers mounted overhead; all birds and all markers stay inside the overlay-safe center, with water reflections blurred and non-countable.
cards.varietyNotes: Multi-subject group + rainbow is the emotional summit; warm gold lifts it out of the grays.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Capstone synergy; rewards a full crew of bonded Basins crew cards.

numberSymbolism.element: ten Mallards beneath ten oval canal-light basin markers mounted over the water
numberSymbolism.represents: family shelter, emotional completion, and shared safety
numberSymbolism.visualRequirement: Show exactly ten Mallards and exactly ten oval canal-light basin markers above them. Keep all ten ducks and all ten markers visible and away from the future border; do not add extra lanterns, bowls, reflected basin markers, countable light dots, or unrelated birds.

cards.repairDirective: Previous candidates had cropped markers and only nine ducks. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with exactly ten same-species Mallards clustered in the center and exactly ten oval basin-light markers fully inside the overlay-safe area. No edge-cropped lights, no extra birds, no missing ducks.

cards.name: Basin Fledgling
cards.description: The youngest of the Tidewatch, a small piping plover bearing a sealed dew-vessel.
cards.pose: Bright-eyed, mid-skitter along the wet bank, carrying a tiny capped vessel in a beak-safe sling.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Fledgling = smallest cast msignal, messenger energy; distinct tiny silhouette.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Cheap utility/messenger crew card; draws or delivers an emotion resource.

cards.name: Basin Outrider
cards.coreMeaning: Romantic pursuit, idealism, following the heart
cards.description: Tidewatch's mobile actor, a Northern Gannet cutting low over the canal on a quest of feeling.
cards.pose: Low fast flight skimming the water surface, long wings swept, pale head angled forward, a small vessel clutched in its talons.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Outrider keeps fast water pursuit but becomes a long-winged seabird instead of a second merganser.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Mobile striker; carries/charges emotion effects across the encounter.

cards.name: Basin Matron
cards.description: The inner master of Tidewatch, a Dalmatian Pelican sitting poised at a modern canal pump station and fountainhead.
cards.pose: Seated and serene on a concrete fountain rim near a canal pump station, massive pouched bill resting over a still vessel nested against her breast.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Matron gains a broad pouched-waterbird silhouette, separating her from the Roseate Spoonbill and other waders.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Support/healer leader; amplifies and protects bonded Basins crew cards.

cards.name: Basin Elder
cards.coreMeaning: Emotional command, calm authority, wisdom of feeling
cards.description: The crew boss of Tidewatch, a monumental Shoebill ruling the calm modern harbor at dusk.
cards.pose: Standing massive and still on a concrete harbor post, huge bill level, wings folded, gaze calm over the water.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Elder becomes unmistakable at card scale through the Shoebill's massive bill and statue-still authority.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Faction leader; command effects that steady and rally the whole Basins crew.
cards.repairDirective: Previous candidates placed the Shoebill head too high so the final border cut it off. Regenerate as high-resolution pixel art only with the entire Shoebill silhouette, head, bill, crown, feet, and harbor-post perch centered lower and fully inside the overlay-safe center. Leave generous empty space above the head for the top border.
